## Nexus main description

**A different beginning.**

Historical Random Start is a 7 Days to Die mod by Bit Wrecked. It gives a new character a random starting location in the active world, then lets the opening journey continue.

Choose any eligible biome, select a particular biome or set relative custom weights. Standard keeps the usual start. Zero weights exclude biomes; displayed shares are previews, and a safe landing is not guaranteed. If no safe destination can be completed, HRS keeps the usual start. A completed landing happens once, including across reloads and normal respawns.

Optional starting-biome protection covers recognized environmental hazards in that biome. Enemies, hazards in other biomes and unrecognized debuffs remain active.

**Get started**

Extract the complete ZIP to a writable local folder outside OneDrive or other synced or linked folders. Close the game, open Steam and run **START.bat**. Enter the exact Game Name for your new save, choose your settings and select **Apply Settings**. Acknowledge **Settings Applied**, select **Launch Game** and create the new game with that same name. A supported existing world can be used for the new save.

The manager provides Help and a separate Game details view. Changes applied confirms verified configuration; Last start reports a recorded game outcome. The README covers upgrades, troubleshooting and removal. Uninstall preserves saves/progress and does not reverse an existing landing or quest.

**Before leaving your first Random session**

**Do not log out until your first trader is assigned. Complete the opening tasks in the same session and wait for the Journey to Settlement trader marker.** You can visit the trader later.

Leaving earlier, including an unexpected session end, may point the quest to a Pine Forest trader when you return. Your landing remains saved and will not repeat. If you already left early, follow the trader marker you receive on return. Standard starts use the game's normal route.

This is a known issue; the reminder does not repair it. A real trader in the landing biome is preferred, but a nearby or same-biome trader is not guaranteed. A valid cross-biome trader fallback is distinct from the early-exit issue.

**Compatibility**

Windows, PowerShell 5.1, local single-player, **EAC disabled** and the game's supplied **0_TFP_Harmony**. Map scope: **Navezgane**; **Random Gen worlds of 8192 or larger**. Bundled pregens and custom maps are outside the tested scope.

The file's release identification states its tested game build. Other builds are best-effort and need separate compatibility testing. HRS keeps the usual start when required hooks are incompatible and does not replace game DLLs.

This **Tech Demo** is a player tryout build. Further polish may follow.
